newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: HERMIS LEAPS, LEADS SHARES HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: HERMIS LEAPS, LEADS SHARES HIGHER.

text.p: * Hermis shares rebounded to 265.50 litas from 250
litas, Vilniaus Bank held at 300 litas.
* Rokishkis Cheese inched up to 48 litas from
47.98 litas.
* Blue-chip official list gained 16.60 points to 1096.05
points.
* The wider group-A index rose 17.87 points to 1861.28
points.
* Brokers say steep gains in blue chips will give way to
cautious growth or stable prices next week.
Hermis Bank shares recovered amid broader gains at the Vilnius bourse on Friday, as brokers prepared themselves for only modest gains next week.
"I'm neutral to optimistic," said one dealer, speaking of the prospects for the market next week.
The blue-chip official list gained 16.60 points to 1096.05 points by the close as the wider group-A index rose 17.87 points to 1861.28 points.
Central market turnover jumped to 1.7 million litas from 528,000 litas.
Hermis Bank shares, which climbed to 265.50 litas, pulled up the official list index, amid a healthy 160,000 litas turnover.
Brokers are divided over whether Hermis shares will stay put or make a run for 300 litas.
"I think Hermis has the potential to reach 300 litas," one broker said.
Hermis saw 20,000 litas worth of block trades at 265 litas.
Vilniaus Bank held steady at 300 litas amid 768,000 litas central market turnover and block trades worth only 3,500 litas at 260 litas to 300 litas.
Brokers say Vilniaus Bank could make it to 315 litas next week.
Shares in Rokishkis Cheese inched up only slightly to 48 litas from 47.98 litas but brokers say they are headed for 50 litas in the coming weeks.
Group-A anchor Lithuanian Gas, back from a three-day suspension, advanced to 1.52 litas from 1.44 litas in central market turnover of 80,000 litas.
The shares were suspended as new isssue hit the market, which brought its share capital up to 339 million litas.
Brokers say Gas shares have long-term potential but prices are hampered in the short-run because of unclear privatisation plans as well as the structure of shareholders.
"There is still a lot of selling by small shareholders that the market needs to absorb," one broker said. "I'd say 1.50 litas is a good point of equilibrium."

Shares in Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company (LISCO) eased to 6.48 litas from 6.50 litas, in thin central market turnover, but are expected to be one of the main advancing issues next week, brokers said.
"LISCO proved to be undervalued and investors are rushing to buy," one trader said. "They already broke the 6.50 litas mark so probably they could reach seven litas next week."
-- Burton Frierson, Vilnius newsroom + 370 2 22 35 18
